name: profilepilot
description: Many isolated profiles of your real, native Chrome, each with its own cookies, logins and proxy, for browsing and scraping.
long_description: ProfilePilot lets Claude drive any number of isolated browser profiles of the Google Chrome (or Edge, Brave, Chromium) already installed on your computer. Every profile has its own cookies, logins, history, storage and cache, and can use its own proxy: HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4 or SOCKS5, with or without username and password (a local relay handles proxy authentication, DNS is resolved at the proxy and WebRTC is limited to the proxy). There is no fingerprint spoofing and no automation flags: pages see a genuine Chrome. Claude works with accessibility snapshots and element refs, reads pages as markdown with hidden prompt-injection text removed, extracts data with CSS/XPath, manages cookies and makes HTTP requests through a profile's proxy and cookies. Profiles keep running in the background and are shared with Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT and Python scripts. Requires Google Chrome, Edge, Brave or Chromium. Claude Desktop installs the Python dependencies with its bundled uv on first start, which can take a minute.

tools.name: profile_list
tools.description: List browser profiles with their proxy and running state.

tools.name: profile_create
tools.description: Create an isolated profile, optionally with a proxy, tags, language or timezone.

tools.name: profile_update
tools.description: Change a profile's name, tags, notes or launch options.

tools.name: profile_delete
tools.description: Move a profile and all its data to the trash.

tools.name: profile_clone
tools.description: Copy a profile's settings, optionally with its data.

tools.name: profile_start
tools.description: Launch a profile's Chrome window.

tools.name: profile_stop
tools.description: Close a profile's Chrome.

tools.name: profile_status
tools.description: Show which profiles are running and their proxy relay statistics.

tools.name: profile_set_proxy
tools.description: Assign or remove a profile's proxy; switches live when the profile is running.

tools.name: proxy_list
tools.description: List saved proxies (passwords are never shown).

tools.name: proxy_add
tools.description: Save one proxy or a whole newline-separated list.

tools.name: proxy_remove
tools.description: Delete a saved proxy.

tools.name: proxy_test
tools.description: Check a proxy's exit IP, country and latency.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Open a URL, or go back, forward or reload.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Accessibility snapshot of the page with element refs to act on.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an element by ref or selector.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text into an element (fill, key by key, human timing or paste), optionally submitting.

tools.name: browser_paste
tools.description: Paste text into an element through the system clipboard, like a person.

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Press a key or key combination.

tools.name: browser_select_option
tools.description: Choose options in a select element.

tools.name: browser_hover
tools.description: Hover over an element.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page or an element into view.

tools.name: browser_wait_for
tools.description: Wait for text, a selector or a number of seconds.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot of the page or one element.

tools.name: browser_read
tools.description: Read the page as markdown, text or HTML, with hidden text removed.

tools.name: browser_extract
tools.description: Extract values with CSS or XPath selectors.

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate a JavaScript expression in the page.

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: List, open, select or close tabs.

tools.name: identity_list
tools.description: List the identities (your saved personal details) used for form autofill.

tools.name: identity_show
tools.description: Show an identity; card, SSN and password values are masked.

tools.name: identity_create
tools.description: Save an identity from details you give (sensitive values only via the CLI).

tools.name: identity_update
tools.description: Change an identity's non-sensitive values.

tools.name: form_detect
tools.description: List the form fields on the page that autofill can fill.

tools.name: form_autofill
tools.description: Fill a form's non-sensitive fields from an identity.

tools.name: form_autofill_sensitive
tools.description: Fill card, SSN or password fields on sites you allowed; asks you first.

tools.name: cookies_get
tools.description: List a profile's cookies (names only by default).

tools.name: cookies_set
tools.description: Add or update cookies in a profile.

tools.name: cookies_clear
tools.description: Delete a profile's cookies, optionally for one domain.

tools.name: cookies_export
tools.description: Export cookies to a JSON or Netscape cookies.txt file.

tools.name: cookies_import
tools.description: Import cookies from a JSON or cookies.txt file.

tools.name: http_fetch
tools.description: HTTP request through a profile's proxy with its cookies.
